The '''RCH-01 shielded turret''' was a type of shielded turret that was used as security emplacements along the road to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sobrik]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Balmorran resistance]] hijacked a number of turrets in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] and turned them against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
